pages.title: Aguas Calientes
pages.extract: Aguas Calientes (now officially Machu Picchu Pueblo) is a small town at the bottom of the valley next to Machu Picchu, and the principal access point to the site. All visitors to Machu Picchu pass through Aguas Calientes and most spend at least one night here.

pages.title: Cloudcroft
pages.description: village in Otero County, New Mexico, United States
pages.extract: Cloudcroft is a town in Southeast New Mexico with a population of less than a thousand.

pages.title: Dordrecht
pages.description: city and municipality in South Holland, the Netherlands
pages.extract: Dordrecht is a historic city in South Holland, Netherlands that was, at the end of the Middle Ages, one of the six important trade cities of the County of Holland. Its centre still shows off the rich history of the city.

pages.title: Exmouth (Western Australia)
pages.extract: Exmouth is a town in Western Australia, midway between Perth and Broome, with a resident population of 2,806 in 2021. The main reasons to visit are to dive Ningaloo Reef, and to see Cape Range National Park.

pages.title: Foça
pages.extract:
Foça is a town in the Central Aegean region of Turkey, 60 km north of Izmir. It's a beach resort easily within a day-trip of the city and in 2019 it had a population of 32,264. 
A second town grew up 20 km north, called Yeni ("New") Foça as it was only established 800 years ago. The original town is therefore sometimes distinguished as Eski ("Old") Foça, and to avoid ambiguity this page does so. So too should you when organising transport and accommodation.

pages.title: Franschhoek
pages.description: town in the Western Cape, South Africa

pages.title: Hulls Cove
pages.extract: Hulls Cove is a village on Mount Desert Island on the coast of Maine, a state of the United States of America.

pages.title: Jingzhou
pages.extract: Jingzhou (荆州 Jīngzhōu) is a city in Hubei Province on the banks of the Yangtze River (长江 Cháng Jiāng).  It has been an important historical city for 6,000 years, and is particularly famous for being the capital for the State of Chu (楚国) during the Warring States Period, and for its importance during the Three Kingdoms Period.

pages.title: Kemer
pages.description: town and district in Antalya Province, Turkey

pages.title: Leenane
pages.description: village and townland in County Galway, Ireland

pages.title: Louisbourg
pages.description: unincorporated town in Nova Scotia, Canada
pages.extract: Louisbourg is a village of 1,000 people (2011) on the south-east coast of Cape Breton Island in Nova Scotia.

pages.title: Macerata (province)
pages.extract: Macerata Province is in Marche Region in Italy. The province contains, among the numerous historical sites, the Roman settlement of Helvia Recina, destroyed by orders of Alaric I, King of the Visigoths, in 408.

pages.title: Mbabane
pages.extract: Mbabane is the largest city of Eswatini (formerly Swaziland). It houses Sibebe Rock, one of the biggest mountains in Africa. It sits on the banks of the Mbabane River and its tributary the Polinjane River in the Mdzimba Mountains, and was home to 95,000 people in 2010.

pages.title: Quinter
pages.description: city in Gove County, Kansas, United States

pages.title: Rutland
pages.extract: There is more than one place called Rutland:

pages.title: Senj
pages.extract: Senj is a town with a population of around 8,000 on the Adriatic coast of Kvarner region of Croatia.

pages.title: Eurobodalla
pages.description: local government area in New South Wales, Australia
pages.extract: The Eurobodalla region of the South Coast in Southeastern New South Wales has an interesting rural/tourist mix. The area is rich in rural charm, having a strong dairy industry. Most of the coastal areas are popular tourist destinations, especially with weekend visitors from Sydney and Canberra.

pages.title: South Florida
pages.description: region of the U.S. state of Florida
pages.extract: South Florida is a region in the U.S. state of Florida. It is a widely diverse area; from its quiet, sparsely-populated central areas with a charming "Old Florida" feel to vibrant, oceanfront resort cities.

pages.title: Tenggol
pages.extract: Tenggol Island (Pulau Tenggol) is in Terengganu, Malaysia.

pages.title: Narcondam Island
pages.extract: Narcondam Island is a small volcanic island part of the Indian territory of Andaman and Nicobar Islands. It is 710 m above sea level at the highest point. The island has an area of 7 km2 (2.7 sq mi).

pages.title: Ohio to Erie Trail
pages.description: long-distance cycling route across the U.S. state of Ohio
pages.extract: The Ohio to Erie Trail is a rail trail in the state of Ohio, spanning from the Ohio River in Cincinnati in the southwestern corner of the state to Cleveland in the northeast. The trail is 85% completed as of December 2014. You can follow the progress of construction and view a map of the trail on its website.

pages.title: Kozhikode District
pages.extract: Kozhikode District or Calicut District is in Malabar, in Kerala, India. The population is 2.8 million and the density is 2,025 people per km2.

pages.title: Willemstad (Netherlands)
pages.extract: Willemstad is a fortified city in the northwest of Noord-Brabant, the Netherlands.
